arxiv-2101-00180.title: Transformer based Automatic COVID-19 Fake News Detection System
arxiv-2101-00180.creator: Sunil Gundapu, Radhika Mamidi
arxiv-2101-00180.description: Abstract Recent rapid technological advancements in online social networks such as Twitter have led to a great incline in spreading false information and fake news. Misinformation is especially prevalent in the ongoing coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, leading to individuals accepting bogus and potentially deleterious claims and articles.

arxiv-2101-11054.title: Remote Learners, Home Makers: How Digital Fabrication Was Taught Online During a Pandemic Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 8–13, 2021; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’21), May 8–13, 2021, Yokohama, Japan DOI: 10.1145/341
arxiv-2101-11054.creator: Gabrielle Benabdallah, Samuelle Bourgault, Nadya Peek, Jennifer Jacobs
arxiv-2101-11054.description: Abstract . Digital fabrication courses that relied on physical makerspaces were severely disrupted by COVID-19. As universities shut down in Spring 2020, instructors developed new models for digital fabrication at a distance. Through interviews with faculty and students and examination of course materials, we recount the experiences of eight remote digital fabrication courses.

arxiv-2112-04276.title: Quantum computing Floquet energy spectra
arxiv-2112-04276.creator: Benedikt Fauseweh, Jian-Xin Zhu
arxiv-2112-04276.description: Abstract Quantum systems can be dynamically controlled using time-periodic external fields, leading to the concept of Floquet engineering, with promising technological applications. Computing Floquet energy spectra is harder than only computing ground state properties or single time-dependent trajectories, and scales exponentially with the Hilbert space dimension.

arxiv-2112-13203.title: Heavy flavor molecular states with strangeness
arxiv-2112-13203.creator: Kan Chen, Bo Wang, Shi-Lin Zhu
arxiv-2112-13203.description: Abstract We proposed a unified framework to describe the interactions of the observed T c ​ c T_{cc} , P c P_{c} , and P c ​ s P_{cs} within a quark level interaction in our previous work. In this work, we generalize our framework to the loosely bound hadronic molecules composed of heavy flavor di-hadrons with strangeness.

arxiv-2201-03887.title: Post maximum light and late time optical imaging polarimetry of type I superluminous supernova 2020znr 2021 Post maximum light and late time optical imaging polarimetry of type I superluminous supernova 2020znr – 14
arxiv-2201-03887.creator: F. Poidevin, C. M. B. Omand, I. Pérez-Fournon, R. Clavero, R. Shirley, R. Marques-Chaves, C. Jimenez Angel, S. Geier
arxiv-2201-03887.description: Abstract Optical imaging polarimetry was conducted on the hydrogen poor superluminous supernova 2020znr during 3 phases after maximum light ( ≈ \approx +34 days, +288 days and +289 days). After instrumental and interstellar polarization correction, all measurements are consistent with null-polarization detection.

arxiv-2207-08080.title: Neural Color Operators for Sequential Image Retouching
arxiv-2207-08080.creator: Yili Wang, Xin Li, Kun Xu, Dongliang He, Qi Zhang, Fu Li, Errui Ding
arxiv-2207-08080.description: Abstract We propose a novel image retouching method by modeling the retouching process as performing a sequence of newly introduced trainable neural color operators . The neural color operator mimics the behavior of traditional color operators and learns pixelwise color transformation while its strength is controlled by a scalar.

arxiv-2312-10396.title: How Far Can Fairness Constraints Help Recover From Biased Data?
arxiv-2312-10396.creator: Mohit Sharma, Amit Deshpande
arxiv-2312-10396.description: Abstract A general belief in fair classification is that fairness constraints incur a trade-off with accuracy, which biased data may worsen. Contrary to this belief, Blum & Stangl [ 8 ] show that fair classification with equal opportunity constraints even on extremely biased data can recover optimally accurate and fair classifiers on the original data distribution.

arxiv-2411-02683.title: Narrow optical linewidths in stoichiometric layered rare-earth crystals
arxiv-2411-02683.creator: Donny R. Pearson Jr, Ashwith Prabhu, Selvin Tobar, Jack D’Amelio, Amy Tram, Zachary W. Riedel, Daniel P. Shoemaker, Elizabeth A. Goldschmidt
arxiv-2411-02683.description: Abstract Rare-earth emitters in solids are well-suited for implementing efficient, long-lived quantum memory coupled to integrated photonics for scalable quantum technologies. They are typically introduced as dopants in a solid-state host, but this introduces disorder and limits the available density of emitters. Stoichiometric materials can offer high densities with narrow optical linewidths.

arxiv-2511-22705.title: A Two Degrees-of-Freedom Floor-Based Robot for Transfer and Rehabilitation Applications Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2511-22705.creator: F. St-Onge, I. Lalonde, J. Denis, M. Lamy, C. Martin, K. Lebel, A. Girard
arxiv-2511-22705.description: Abstract The ability to accomplish a sit-to-stand (STS) motion is key to increase functional mobility and reduce rehospitalization risks. While raising aid (transfer) devices and partial bodyweight support (rehabilitation) devices exist, both are unable to adjust the STS training to different mobility levels.

pmc-10710939.title: Discovery of a novel acaricide, acynonapyr
pmc-10710939.creator: Isami Hamamoto, Masahiro Kawaguchi, Takehiko Nakamura, Makio Yano, Keiji Koizumi, Jun Takahashi
pmc-10710939.description: Acynonapyr, discovered by Nippon Soda Co., Ltd., is a novel acaricide with N-pyridyloxy azabicycle as a unique core structure. Acynonapyr exhibits high activity against the spider mite species in the genera Tetranychus and Panonychus, with good efficacy at all life stages.

pmc-10719240.title: Insights into the shape-dependent effects of polyethylene microplastics on interactions with organisms, environmental aging, and adsorption properties
pmc-10719240.creator: Ula Rozman, Barbara Klun, Aleksandra Kuljanin, Tina Skalar, Gabriela Kalčíková
pmc-10719240.description: The shape-dependent effects of microplastics have been studied in the context of ingestion but have not been considered in other environmental processes. Therefore, we investigated how the shape of polyethylene microplastics (spheres, fragments, and films) affects interactions with plants, aging, and their adsorption properties.

pmc-11359599.title: Tracking Measles and Rubella Elimination Progress—World Health Organization African Region, 2022–2023
pmc-11359599.creator: Balcha G. Masresha, Charles Shey Wiysonge, Reggis Katsande, Patrick Michael O’Connor, Emmaculate Lebo, Robert T. Perry
pmc-11359599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Measles or rubella elimination is verified when endemic transmission of the corresponding virus has been absent for over 36 months in a defined area, in the presence of a well-performing surveillance system. This report updates the progress by 47 countries in the WHO African Region towards the goal of attaining verification of measles and rubella elimination in at least 80% of the countries of the region by 2030.

pmc-11655178.title: pH: A major player in degenerative intervertebral disks
pmc-11655178.creator: Matthew A R Trone, Joshua D Stover, Alejandro Almarza, Robert D Bowles
pmc-11655178.description: Chronic lower back pain is the leading cause of disability worldwide, generating a socioeconomic cost of over $100 billion annually in the United States. Among the prominent causes of low back pain (LBP) is degeneration of the intervertebral disk (IVD), a condition known as degenerative disk disease (DDD).

pmc-12624133.title: Advancing decision making with distance and similarity measures for belief and plausibility in Fermatean fuzzy sets
pmc-12624133.creator: Rashid Hussain, Zahid Hussain, Mehboob Ali, Yasir Akhtar, Muhammed I Syam
pmc-12624133.description: Fermatean fuzzy sets (FFSs) have become a potent tool for modeling uncertainty in decision-making, offering a higher degree of flexibility compared to traditional fuzzy and intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IFSs). Within the context of evidence theory, the notions of belief and plausibility enhance the representational capacity of FFSs, enabling the handling of ambiguous and conflicting data.

pmc-12631760.title: Reference values and biological factors influencing skin autofluorescence
pmc-12631760.creator: Bruce H.R. Wolffenbuttel, Henderikus E. Boersma, Robert van Waateringe, Andrew D. Paterson, Melanie M. van der Klauw
pmc-12631760.description: IntroductionTissue glycation, measured as skin autofluorescence (SAF) with an AGE Reader, has been associated with incident type 2 diabetes (T2D), cardiovascular disease (CVD), and CVD and cancer mortality. Validated reference intervals in healthy individuals are needed to make useful and precise risk estimations.

pmc-12721111.title: Radiological analysis correlated with neurological outcomes following resection of myxopapillary ependymoma: patient series
pmc-12721111.creator: Nitish Seenarine, Noah M Nichols, John K Houten, Konstantinos Margetis
pmc-12721111.description: BACKGROUNDMyxopapillary ependymomas (MPEs) are rare intradural extramedullary tumors that often involve the conus and cauda equina. Current guidelines recommend resection as first-line management, but, despite a 92.4% overall 10-year survival rate, MPEs often have a high potential for postoperative morbidity with persisting or worsened neurological function.

pmc-13238201.title: Association between fibrinogen–albumin ratio and outcomes in myocardial infarction: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13238201.creator: Peng Xu, Hua Xu, Si Shen, Jiahui Zhu, Wenxi Shen
pmc-13238201.description: Background & Objective:The fibrinogen–albumin ratio (FAR) is an emerging biomarker that reflects systemic inflammation and coagulation balance. Its prognostic significance in myocardial infarction (MI) remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the association between FAR and clinical outcomes in MI patients.
